hero.title: The Five-Year Goal, carried by each one of us
hero.subtitle: Fourteen axes, forty actions, five years. Shephr is the tool that lets every member, every assembly and every country declare their commitments, roll them up and track their fulfilment through to 31 December 2030.
hero.note: Create your account for free to join your assembly and declare your commitments. Rolling out a whole ministry is done with our support — write to us to get started.

quinquennat.kicker: A word of encouragement from the Lord — RAM 2025
quinquennat.quote1: Take the five-year goal as a joy, as a gift I am giving you. I have made you great, and look at what I have done of you and for you; this is only a beginning.
quinquennat.quote2: When this goal is accomplished, it will not only mark the completion of activities and projects; it will reveal transformed people — men and women of weight, of reference and of lasting fruit.
quinquennat.source: RAM 2025, Ndoumbi (Bertoua — Cameroon), under the direction of our Leader Brother Theodore Andoseh
quinquennat.contextTitle: A plan for the whole life of the Ministry
quinquennat.context: The Five-Year Goal is the fruit of the work held from 22 to 27 December 2025 in Abidjan by the delegates of the Abidjan 2024 Special Summit, joined by other leaders of the Ministry: fourteen axes covering the entire life of our Ministry, broken down into forty precise actions to be carried out from 2026 to 2030.

goals.title: From each one's faith to the Goal accomplished
goals.subtitle: Find in it what you will personally carry. Shephr gathers each person's commitment, rolls it up level by level and makes visible, year after year, where we truly stand.

faith.title: Commitment by faith
faith.desc: Everyone declares what they carry — by faith, not by calculation. Once submitted, the commitment is locked: a single act, laid before the Lord.

aggregate.title: Roll-up at every level
aggregate.desc: The goal retained is the maximum between the roll-up of the sub-levels and the leader's own commitment of faith: no one aims below what their own people carry.

progress.title: The real state, year after year
progress.desc: The Goal plays out over five years. Each year, you declare where you truly stand, before the deadline set by the secretariat — and the trend stays visible.

levels.title: From the member to the continent
levels.desc: Member, assembly, region, country, continent: the same declaration travels up the whole chain, with no re-entry or spreadsheets, with dashboards and exports at every level.

features.title: And everything else in the life of the ministry
features.subtitle: Around the goals, the modules that carry your assembly's daily life.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Shephr is a management platform for ministries and churches. This policy explains what data we collect, why, who can see it and how you stay in control of it. It applies to the Shephr mobile app as well as to the website.
privacy.controllerTitle: Who is responsible for your data
privacy.controllerText: Shephr is published by JEXCELLENCE SAS, 9 rue des Colonnes, 75002 Paris, France, the controller for the processing described here. Your ministry or church, which decides who is enrolled and which modules are enabled, is a joint controller for its members' data.
privacy.controllerContact: For any question about your data, write to us at
privacy.collectedIntro: We only collect what the app needs to work. No data is collected in the background without your knowledge.

collected.account: Account: first and last name, sign-in identifier (email address), phone number and country code, password (stored encrypted, never in clear text).
collected.org: Organization: your attachments (ministry, region, city, assembly), your roles and the scope you have rights over.
collected.goals: Goals: the commitments you declare, their amounts and how they progress over time.
collected.donations: Donations: the contributions you declare — amount, currency, date and category. Shephr processes no payments and collects no banking data.
collected.memberCare: Member care: when a leader supports you, the follow-up information they record (progress status, first meeting date, contact details, notes).
collected.technical: Technical: sign-in logs and security data (sign-in date, IP address, device type) needed to run the service and protect accounts.

noTracking.sale: We do not sell or rent your data to anyone.
noTracking.ads: We display no advertising and feed no advertising network.
noTracking.analytics: The app embeds no audience-measurement or third-party tracking tool.
noTracking.sensors: The app accesses neither your location, nor your contacts, nor your camera, nor your microphone.

purpose.service: Create your account, authenticate you and give you access to your ministry's modules — the service cannot work without this data.
purpose.org: Attach each person to their assembly, apply roles, and consolidate goals and donations across the levels of the organization.
purpose.support: Answer your support requests when you write to us.
purpose.security: Detect abnormal access, prevent abuse and keep accounts secure.
purpose.legal: Meet our legal obligations, in particular accounting ones for donation records.

privacy.sensitiveText: Your membership of a church and member care records reveal religious beliefs. This is sensitive data and we treat it as such: access is restricted to the leaders responsible for your scope, it is never shared for commercial purposes and never used outside the life of your ministry.
privacy.sensitiveBasis: This data is only processed as part of your voluntary participation in your ministry, and you can request its deletion at any time.
privacy.visibilityTitle: Who can see your data in the app
privacy.visibilityText: Shephr mirrors your ministry's organization: each leader only sees the scope they are responsible for. Your assembly's leader sees the members of that assembly, a regional leader sees the assemblies in their region, and so on up to the international secretariat.
privacy.visibilityScope: Other members have no access to your goals, your donations or your member care records. None of this data is public or reachable outside your organization.
privacy.sharingText: We share your data with no third party for commercial purposes. We only rely on the technical providers needed to run the service, which act on our instructions and may not use your data for their own purposes.

sharing.hosting: Hosting: our servers and database are hosted with Railway, our cloud infrastructure provider. Railway acts as a processor: it hosts the data without accessing it for its own purposes.
sharing.region: Location: your data is hosted in the European Union, in Railway's EU West region, in Amsterdam (Netherlands). It is not stored outside the European Union. As Railway is a company established in the United States, any technical intervention on its part from another country is governed by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.
sharing.transfer: We may also disclose data where the law requires it, at the request of a competent authority.

privacy.retentionText: We keep your data for as long as your account is active. After a deletion request, your account and the associated data are removed from our active systems within 30 days at most.
privacy.retentionLegal: Some data may be kept longer when required by law — for example donation records, for accounting obligations — then deleted once the legal retention period ends.
privacy.rightsIntro: Under the GDPR and equivalent regulations, you have the following rights:

rights.access: Access the data we hold about you and obtain a copy of it.
rights.rectify: Correct inaccurate information — most of it can be edited directly in the app, in your settings.
rights.delete: Request the deletion of your account and the associated data.
rights.portability: Receive your data in a readable, reusable format.
rights.object: Object to a processing activity or request that it be restricted.
rights.complaint: Lodge a complaint with the data protection authority in your country.

privacy.rightsHow: To exercise any of these rights, write to us at the address below. Deletion can also be done directly in the app, under Settings:
privacy.deleteLink: request the deletion of my account
privacy.securityText: Traffic between the app and our servers is encrypted (HTTPS), passwords are stored as non-reversible hashes, and access to data is partitioned by scope and by role.
privacy.securityBreach: Should a data breach put you at risk, we will notify you and the competent authorities within the timeframes set by the regulation.
privacy.childrenText: Shephr is intended for the members and leaders of a ministry. A minor may only be enrolled with the consent of their parents or legal guardian, who can request the deletion of the account at any time.
privacy.changesText: This policy may evolve along with the app. In case of a significant change, we update the date at the top of this page and notify you in the app.
privacy.contactText: A question about your data, an access or deletion request? Write to us and we will get back to you.
privacy.mailSubject: Shephr — question about my personal data
privacy.whatsappText: Hello, I have a question about the privacy of my Shephr data.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your Shephr account
deleteAccount.intro: You can request the deletion of your Shephr account and the data associated with it at any time. This page explains how to proceed, what gets deleted and within which timeframe.
deleteAccount.step1: Send us an email (button below) mentioning the identifier you use to sign in to the app.
deleteAccount.step2: If possible, include the name of your ministry or church to help us find your account.
deleteAccount.step3: We confirm that your request has been received, then delete your account and the associated data.
deleteAccount.cta: Request the deletion of my account
deleteAccount.mailBody:
Hello,

I would like my Shephr account and the associated data to be deleted.

Sign-in identifier: 
Ministry / church: 

Thank you.

deleted.profile: Your profile: name, sign-in identifier, contact details and password.
deleted.assignments: Your attachments to the organization (ministry, region, city, assembly) and your roles.
deleted.activity: Data linked to your activity in the app (declared goals, member care records, preferences).

deleteAccount.inAppText: Account deletion is now available directly in the app: sign in, then open Settings → Delete my account. The email request below remains available as an alternative.
deleteAccount.retentionDelay: Requests are processed within 30 days at most. Once the deletion is done, your account can no longer be accessed and your data is removed from our active systems.
deleteAccount.retentionLegal: Some data may be kept longer when required by law (for example donation records, for accounting obligations), then deleted once the legal retention period ends.
